stanzas: reign for the dread of [our] enemies,

notes: Romanization: scientific transliteration (х = x, ц = c, ж = ž, й = j, ы = y, я = ja, ь = ʹ). This text is printed in the modern spelling (no ъ, і or ѣ), so there is nothing of the old orthography to transliterate.
line 2: державный (deržavnyj) is 'sovereign, ruling', from держава, 'realm' and also the orb of royal power.
lines 3-4: на славу нам / на страх врагам: literally 'to glory for us' / 'to fear for enemies', i.e. reign so that we have glory and the enemies dread; 'our' before enemies is supplied.
